integrity: The proof derives every fiber using complementary lines and the characteristic polynomial, then counts each conjugacy stratum. A standalone exact finite-field checker corroborates instances with q=2,3,4,5,7; finite checks alone are not an infinite proof. All external research comparisons remain best-knowledge.
scientific_limitations: Two-by-two matrices over finite fields only; general matrix sizes and nonfield coefficient rings are not covered. Prior work already treated nil-clean existence and several maximum-index cases; only the complete all-field fiber histogram and its algebraic derivation are put forward. An inaccessible 2018 dissertation may contain some additional prime-field index information. No claim of independent priority certification.
title: Complete nil-clean decomposition-fiber distributions for two-dimensional finite-field matrices
